title: Heat Advisory for NYC: 11:00 AM on 8/6 to 8:00 PM on 8/7.
message: Seek a cool space, avoid strenuous outdoor activity, and stay hydrated. For more info and safety tips, visit nyc.gov/beattheheat or weather.gov/okx. Multilingual and ASL link: on.nyc.gov/2rjosBI.
